steps.text: Kirchhoff's first law: current into a junction equals current out (charge conservation).
Kirchhoff's second law: the EMFs around a loop equal the p.d.s (energy conservation).
Series: same current, resistances add. Parallel: same p.d., reciprocal resistances add.
A real cell has internal resistance r: terminal p.d. = EMF − Ir.
Potential divider: V_out = V_in × R₂/(R₁ + R₂).
Maximum power is delivered to the load when load resistance equals internal resistance.
